about: Written by hand for ace-mod-splunk's tests of PLAN.md decisions 52 and 53 (see tickets_overflow's about). The instance is example_user_risk_detections on the azure_user_id 0b6c2c56-1d1e-4f7a-9d3e-6a2f00000001 (made up) with the root's event time 2026-11-02T12:00:00Z, use_index_time true, a 30-day-before, 1-minute-after <TIMESPEC>. Its observable_mapping: userPrincipalName -> email_address, ipAddress and related_client_ip -> ip, user_agent -> user_agent, each with ignored_values: [""]. Expected observables: email_address alice@example.com; ip 203.0.113.45 (once, from two rows and two fields), 198.51.100.77, 198.51.100.78; user_agent 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)' and 'curl/8.5.0'. The blank values give none, nor does 'not-an-ip' (not an IP address). Summary 'Example Risk Detections: (3 results)'.
